source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-57

procedures.title: Horn relay-buzzer: buzzer check
steps: If the buzzer now works, check the ignition switch and its wiring.
If it still does not, connect a voltmeter from terminal No. 1 to ground.
Zero volts means an open circuit between that point and the battery.
If voltage is present, replace the horn relay-buzzer.

procedures.title: Horn relay-buzzer: horn relay check
steps: Remove the horn relay-buzzer and find terminals No. 2 and No. 3.
Jumper terminal No. 2 to ground (use a prod in the connector for slip-on terminals).
If the horns sound, check the No. 2 terminal wire and the horn switch.
If they do not, keep No. 2 grounded and connect a voltmeter from No. 3 to ground.
With a reading, check the horn wiring and horns.
With no reading, replace the horn relay-buzzer.
